headline: Inflation in India Accelerates Sharply in September, Highest Since December 2024
summary: Consumer prices in India rose 5.54% year-on-year in September, the fastest pace since October 2024, the statistics office reported. The reading marks a sharp acceleration in inflation.
why: Consumer price inflation shapes Reserve Bank of India interest-rate decisions, which affect bond yields, the rupee and borrowing costs.
